## Purpose and experimental design

Corn grain yield was measured at Musgrave Research Farm in 2026 in a split-plot
randomized complete block design with four blocks. Clover species (mammoth red
clover and yellow sweetclover) was assigned to whole plots; management was
assigned to subplots. The **core trial** compares Tillage, Strip-till, and V4
inter-row mowing. The **mowing trial** compares four strip-till treatments:
Strip-till, V4 inter-row mowing, V4 autonomous mowing, and Biweekly autonomous
mowing (beginning at V4 and continuing every two weeks through VT).

These two analyses share the Strip-till and V4 inter-row mowing observations;
they are complementary comparisons, **not independent experiments**. Only
Musgrave yield data are available at present. Grain weights were recorded after
shelling and subsequent oven drying to near 0% moisture. Yield is reported at
15.5% grain moisture, primarily in kg ha^-1, with bu ac^-1 for reference.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)

figure_dir <- here("figures", "corn_yield")
table_dir <- here("output", "tables", "corn_yield")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 16))

species_colors <- c("Mammoth red clover" = "#C77C7D",
                    "Yellow sweetclover" = "#E9E6BD")
core_levels <- c("Tillage", "Strip-till", "V4 inter-row mowing")
mowing_levels <- c("Strip-till", "V4 inter-row mowing",
                   "V4 autonomous mowing", "Biweekly autonomous mowing")
all_levels <- c("Tillage", mowing_levels)
save_figure <- function(p, name, width = 11, height = 6) {
  ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, name), plot = p, width = width,
         height = height, units = "in", dpi = 300)
}
write_table <- function(x, name) {
  write.csv(as.data.frame(x), file.path(table_dir, name),
            row.names = FALSE, na = "")
}
```

## Data import and validation

Four 8.75-ft harvest transects per subplot, each in a 30-in row, represent
87.5 ft^2. Oven-dry grain weight is converted to dry yield per hectare, divided
by 0.845 for yield at 15.5% moisture, and converted to bu ac^-1 using
56 lb bu^-1 for shelled corn. The source data were processed previously; these
calculations are checked here, not recomputed as analysis variables.

```{r import-validation}
path <- here("data", "processed", "combined_processed.rds")
stopifnot(file.exists(path))
dat <- readRDS(path)
required <- c("location", "block_id", "whole_plot_id", "plot_id",
              "clover_species", "management", "grain_weight_g",
              "grain_yield_dry_kg_ha", "grain_yield_kg_ha",
              "grain_yield_bu_ac")
if (length(missing_columns <- setdiff(required, names(dat))))
  stop("Missing columns: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))

musgrave <- dat |>
  filter(as.character(location) == "musgrave") |>
  mutate(clover_species = factor(as.character(clover_species),
                                 levels = names(species_colors)),
         management = factor(dplyr::recode(as.character(management),
                   "Between-row autonomous mowing" = "Biweekly autonomous mowing"),
                   levels = all_levels),
         block_id = factor(block_id),
         whole_plot_id = factor(whole_plot_id))

if (nrow(musgrave) != 40 || anyDuplicated(musgrave$plot_id))
  stop("Expected 40 unique Musgrave subplot records")
if (anyNA(musgrave[required])) stop("Missing design or yield values at Musgrave")
if (anyNA(musgrave[c("clover_species", "management")]))
  stop("Unrecognized treatment level")
yield_columns <- c("grain_weight_g", "grain_yield_dry_kg_ha",
                   "grain_yield_kg_ha", "grain_yield_bu_ac")
if (any(!is.finite(as.matrix(musgrave[yield_columns]))) ||
    any(as.matrix(musgrave[yield_columns]) <= 0))
  stop("Missing, nonfinite or nonpositive grain yield or grain weight")

design <- musgrave |>
  group_by(block_id, clover_species, whole_plot_id) |>
  summarise(n_subplots = n(), n_treatments = n_distinct(management),
            .groups = "drop")
if (n_distinct(musgrave$block_id) != 4 || nrow(design) != 8 ||
    any(design$n_subplots != 5) || any(design$n_treatments != 5) ||
    any(design |> count(whole_plot_id) |> pull(n) != 1) ||
    any(musgrave |> count(block_id, management) |> pull(n) != 2))
  stop("Unexpected Musgrave split-plot assignment")

harvest_area_m2 <- 4 * 8.75 * 2.5 * 0.09290304
calculated_dry <- musgrave$grain_weight_g / 1000 / harvest_area_m2 * 10000
calculated_155 <- calculated_dry / (1 - 0.155)
calculated_bu_ac <- calculated_155 * 2.20462262185 /
  2.47105381467 / 56
if (!isTRUE(all.equal(musgrave$grain_yield_dry_kg_ha, calculated_dry,
                      tolerance = 1e-5)) ||
    !isTRUE(all.equal(musgrave$grain_yield_kg_ha, calculated_155,
                      tolerance = 1e-5)) ||
    !isTRUE(all.equal(musgrave$grain_yield_bu_ac, calculated_bu_ac,
                      tolerance = 1e-5)))
  stop("Yield conversions do not agree with oven-dry grain weight")

core <- musgrave |>
  filter(management %in% core_levels) |>
  mutate(management = factor(as.character(management), levels = core_levels))
mowing <- musgrave |>
  filter(management %in% mowing_levels) |>
  mutate(management = factor(as.character(management), levels = mowing_levels))
stopifnot(nrow(core) == 24, nrow(mowing) == 32,
          n_distinct(core$whole_plot_id) == 8,
          n_distinct(mowing$whole_plot_id) == 8)
knitr::kable(design, caption = "Musgrave whole-plot design check")
write_table(design, "musgrave_yield_design.csv")
```

## Descriptive treatment summaries

Tables and figures report **observed means ± raw standard errors**, with four
blocks contributing one observation to each species × management combination.
These are not model-estimated means.

```{r descriptive-summaries}
summarise_yield <- function(x) {
  x |>
    group_by(clover_species, management) |>
    summarise(n = n(), mean_kg_ha = mean(grain_yield_kg_ha),
              sd_kg_ha = sd(grain_yield_kg_ha),
              se_kg_ha = sd_kg_ha / sqrt(n),
              mean_bu_ac = mean(grain_yield_bu_ac),
              se_bu_ac = sd(grain_yield_bu_ac) / sqrt(n),
              .groups = "drop")
}
core_summary <- summarise_yield(core)
mowing_summary <- summarise_yield(mowing)
knitr::kable(core_summary, digits = 1,
             caption = "Core trial: raw corn grain yield means and SE")
knitr::kable(mowing_summary, digits = 1,
             caption = "Mowing trial: raw corn grain yield means and SE")
write_table(core_summary, "core_grain_yield_means.csv")
write_table(mowing_summary, "mowing_grain_yield_means.csv")
```

## Descriptive figures

The panels use the established clover colors and show raw means ± SE.
Management labels remain horizontal. Statistical letters, if warranted, are
reported separately with model-based comparisons rather than overlaid on raw
descriptive summaries.

```{r yield-figure-helper, include=FALSE}
yield_figure <- function(x, plot_title) {
  ggplot(x, aes(x = management, y = mean_kg_ha, fill = clover_species)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = .8), width = .7,
             color = "black", linewidth = .3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(0, mean_kg_ha - se_kg_ha),
                      ymax = mean_kg_ha + se_kg_ha),
                  position = position_dodge(width = .8), width = .16) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = species_colors) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = scales::label_wrap(17)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .08))) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = NULL,
         y = expression("Corn grain yield (kg ha"^{-1}*")"),
         fill = "Clover species",
         caption = "Observed treatment means ± raw SE (n = 4 blocks per cell); 15.5% moisture.") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = .5, size = 11),
          legend.position = "bottom", plot.caption = element_text(size = 11))
}
```

### Core trial: grain yield

```{r core-yield-figure, fig.width=11, fig.height=6}
core_fig <- yield_figure(core_summary, "Corn grain yield: Core trial")
print(core_fig)
save_figure(core_fig, "core_grain_yield.png", 11, 6)
```

### Mowing trial: grain yield

```{r mowing-yield-figure, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
mowing_fig <- yield_figure(mowing_summary, "Corn grain yield: Mowing trial")
print(mowing_fig)
save_figure(mowing_fig, "mowing_grain_yield.png", 12, 6)
```

## Linear mixed models

Initial models are Gaussian LMMs on untransformed grain yield (kg ha^-1).
Species, management, and their interaction are fixed; block and the clover
whole plot within block are random intercepts. `whole_plot_id` is unique
across blocks, so `(1 | block_id) + (1 | whole_plot_id)` encodes the intended
nesting. Sum-to-zero contrasts support Type III tests with the interaction
included. No covariates or alternative distributions are considered unless
diagnostics indicate a need.

```{r model-helpers, include=FALSE}
fit_yield_model <- function(x) {
  contrasts(x$clover_species) <- contr.sum(nlevels(x$clover_species))
  contrasts(x$management) <- contr.sum(nlevels(x$management))
  lmerTest::lmer(grain_yield_kg_ha ~ clover_species * management +
                   (1 | block_id) + (1 | whole_plot_id), data = x,
                 REML = TRUE)
}
anova_table <- function(model) {
  a <- as.data.frame(anova(model, type = 3, ddf = "Satterthwaite"))
  data.frame(effect = rownames(a), a, row.names = NULL, check.names = FALSE)
}
```

### Core trial: model and ANOVA

```{r core-model}
core_model <- fit_yield_model(core)
core_anova <- anova_table(core_model)
knitr::kable(core_anova, digits = 4,
             caption = "Core trial: Type III ANOVA (Satterthwaite df)")
write_table(core_anova, "core_yield_anova.csv")
cat("Singular fit:", lme4::isSingular(core_model), "\n")
print(summary(core_model))
```

### Core trial: diagnostics

```{r core-diagnostics, fig.width=10, fig.height=4.5}
core_diag <- data.frame(fitted = fitted(core_model),
                        residual = resid(core_model))
p_core_resid <- ggplot(core_diag, aes(fitted, residual)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  labs(x = "Fitted grain yield (kg/ha)", y = "Residual (kg/ha)",
       title = "Core: residuals vs fitted")
p_core_qq <- ggplot(core_diag, aes(sample = residual)) +
  stat_qq() + stat_qq_line() +
  labs(title = "Core: residual Q-Q plot")
print(p_core_resid)
print(p_core_qq)
save_figure(p_core_resid, "core_residuals.png", 7, 5)
save_figure(p_core_qq, "core_qq.png", 7, 5)
```

### Mowing trial: model and ANOVA

```{r mowing-model}
mowing_model <- fit_yield_model(mowing)
mowing_anova <- anova_table(mowing_model)
knitr::kable(mowing_anova, digits = 4,
             caption = "Mowing trial: Type III ANOVA (Satterthwaite df)")
write_table(mowing_anova, "mowing_yield_anova.csv")
cat("Singular fit:", lme4::isSingular(mowing_model), "\n")
print(summary(mowing_model))
```

### Mowing trial: diagnostics

```{r mowing-diagnostics, fig.width=10, fig.height=4.5}
mowing_diag <- data.frame(fitted = fitted(mowing_model),
                          residual = resid(mowing_model))
p_mowing_resid <- ggplot(mowing_diag, aes(fitted, residual)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  labs(x = "Fitted grain yield (kg/ha)", y = "Residual (kg/ha)",
       title = "Mowing: residuals vs fitted")
p_mowing_qq <- ggplot(mowing_diag, aes(sample = residual)) +
  stat_qq() + stat_qq_line() +
  labs(title = "Mowing: residual Q-Q plot")
print(p_mowing_resid)
print(p_mowing_qq)
save_figure(p_mowing_resid, "mowing_residuals.png", 7, 5)
save_figure(p_mowing_qq, "mowing_qq.png", 7, 5)
```

## Model-estimated means and post-hoc comparisons

Model-based means are supplied for transparency, separately from the raw
figures. If the species × management interaction is significant at alpha =
0.05, compare management treatments *within each species*. Otherwise, compare
the marginal management means only if the management main effect is significant,
and marginal species means only if the species main effect is significant.
Pairwise comparisons use **unadjusted Fisher's LSD-style p-values** (`adjust =
"none"`), conditional on the relevant omnibus test. These comparisons are
exploratory, not multiplicity-adjusted. Where comparisons are conducted, CLDs
use lowercase letters with `a` assigned to the highest model mean; shared
letters indicate that a difference was not detected, not equivalence.

```{r comparison-helper, include=FALSE}
get_p <- function(a, term) a[["Pr(>F)"]][match(term, a$effect)]
report_emmeans <- function(model, a, prefix) {
  cell_means <- as.data.frame(emmeans(model, ~ clover_species * management))
  write_table(cell_means, paste0(prefix, "_cell_emmeans.csv"))
  knitr::kable(cell_means, digits = 2,
               caption = paste(prefix, "model-estimated species × management means")) |>
    print()

  interaction_p <- get_p(a, "clover_species:management")
  management_p <- get_p(a, "management")
  species_p <- get_p(a, "clover_species")
  if (is.na(interaction_p) || is.na(management_p) || is.na(species_p))
    stop("Could not locate fixed-effect p-values in ANOVA table")

  if (interaction_p < .05) {
    emm <- emmeans(model, ~ management | clover_species)
    pairs_out <- as.data.frame(pairs(emm, adjust = "none"))
    write_table(pairs_out, paste0(prefix, "_management_within_species_LSD.csv"))
    print(knitr::kable(pairs_out, digits = 3,
           caption = paste(prefix, "management comparisons within species (unadjusted)")))
    if (requireNamespace("multcomp", quietly = TRUE) &&
        requireNamespace("multcompView", quietly = TRUE)) {
      letters_out <- as.data.frame(multcomp::cld(
        emm, adjust = "none", Letters = letters, sort = TRUE, reversed = TRUE))
      write_table(letters_out, paste0(prefix, "_management_within_species_CLD.csv"))
      print(knitr::kable(letters_out, digits = 2,
             caption = paste(prefix, "within-species LSD letter groupings")))
    } else cat("Install multcomp and multcompView to obtain CLD letters.\n")
  } else {
    cat("Species × management interaction not significant; examining marginal effects.\n")
    if (management_p < .05) {
      emm <- emmeans(model, ~ management)
      pairs_out <- as.data.frame(pairs(emm, adjust = "none"))
      write_table(pairs_out, paste0(prefix, "_management_LSD.csv"))
      print(knitr::kable(pairs_out, digits = 3,
             caption = paste(prefix, "management comparisons (unadjusted)")))
      if (requireNamespace("multcomp", quietly = TRUE) &&
          requireNamespace("multcompView", quietly = TRUE)) {
        letters_out <- as.data.frame(multcomp::cld(
          emm, adjust = "none", Letters = letters, sort = TRUE, reversed = TRUE))
        write_table(letters_out, paste0(prefix, "_management_CLD.csv"))
        print(knitr::kable(letters_out, digits = 2,
               caption = paste(prefix, "management LSD letter groupings")))
      } else cat("Install multcomp and multcompView to obtain CLD letters.\n")
    } else cat("Management main effect not significant; no management post-hoc tests.\n")
    if (species_p < .05) {
      emm <- emmeans(model, ~ clover_species)
      pairs_out <- as.data.frame(pairs(emm, adjust = "none"))
      write_table(pairs_out, paste0(prefix, "_species_LSD.csv"))
      print(knitr::kable(pairs_out, digits = 3,
             caption = paste(prefix, "clover species comparison (unadjusted)")))
    } else cat("Clover species main effect not significant.\n")
  }
}
```

### Core trial: estimated means and comparisons

```{r core-comparisons}
report_emmeans(core_model, core_anova, "core")
```

### Mowing trial: estimated means and comparisons

```{r mowing-comparisons}
report_emmeans(mowing_model, mowing_anova, "mowing")
```

## Preliminary interpretation

The figures present treatment means without inferential annotation. Interpret
the ANOVA and any model-based post-hoc comparisons only after reviewing the
diagnostic plots, checking convergence and singularity, and confirming that the
Gaussian error assumption is reasonable. With one site-year, results apply to
Musgrave 2026; additional site-years can be incorporated in a subsequent
analysis without altering this preliminary record.
